question: Does affine RMS normalization of the per-token SwiGLU product improve the adopted D256 tokenizer MLA recipe after equally bounded LR tuning?

architecture_review.rationale: Distinct from block RMS-vs-LayerNorm and gated-vs-ungated structure. Character width256 RMS mean gain0.003438 was small and failed the full rule, so it is only a weak prior; transfer to GPT2-tokenized MLA is untested. Avoid further attention-only refinements.

deferred.QK normalization: Character width256 worsened in all three seeds; score tuning just completed.
deferred.short convolution: Distinct local-mixing question remains useful, but requires additional cache-history contracts.
deferred.MoE: Distinct capacity question remains deferred until a complete measured resource design fits.

hp_review.rationale: Character fixed-LR width256 mean gain0.000805 was small and mixed; no present instability evidence establishes a warmup mechanism. Defer rather than infer stability from higher-LR CE degradation.

proposal.backbone: adopted D256 MLA multiplier0.5, SwiGLU672/SiLU, block RMSNorm, final affine LayerNorm, grouped-embeddingv2, H200
proposal.placement: per-token after silu(gate(x))*up(x), before unchanged down projection
proposal.optimizer_proposal: new norm gains use AdamW base LR and independent decay; preserve existing matrix and embedding groups
